fidelity_checks.LCOE_calculation: Implemented exactly as PVF-based annuity formula from Müller et al. (2023)
fidelity_checks.Technology_choice: Least-cost PV vs wind selection per hexagon
fidelity_checks.LCOH_production: Electrolyzer CAPEX/OPEX annuity + electricity cost + water cost
fidelity_checks.Downstream_chain: Ammonia synthesis + shipping + cracking + local truck adders (not full PyPSA optimization, but transparent static adders)
fidelity_checks.European_benchmark: Identical model equations with European CFs and CAPEX
fidelity_checks.Scenarios: Three WACC levels capturing de-risking gradient

deviations: Full hourly PyPSA dispatch optimization is omitted for transparency and reproducibility; instead we use static capacity factors and annuity-based LCOH. This is a simplification but preserves the comparative structure.
